last_response.name: eidolon-impact-ring
last_response.message: A one-shot, 8 frames at 12 fps, on a transparent background, seen from slightly above: a white star flash with short rays, then a white and pale gold ring spreading flat across the ground, with gold rock chips and dust flung out, all fading to nothing by the last frame. Palette is white and pale gold only, with hard pixel edges. The dust puffs are faint at this size, so the Size and Dust sliders in the page are the first things to try if you want more of them.
